title: Ability to configure notifications for all events with apps that don't support per-event settings
line: Apps without their own notification events, like web browsers, now have a "Play a sound" option in their notification settings.
explanation: Applications that send plain notifications without shipping a notifyrc file (Firefox, Chrome, most non-KDE apps) only had popup, history and badge settings; sounds could only be configured per event, which these apps don't have, so the page just said per-event configuration isn't supported. The notification server only played a sound when the app itself asked for one in the notification hints. The change adds PlaySound and Sound to the per-app behavior settings, shows a "Play a sound" checkbox with preview, sound name field, reset and file chooser on the settings page of apps without events (and Other Applications), and makes plasmashell play that sound when such an app's notification pops up without its own sound.

commits.message:
kcms/notifications: allow playing a sound for apps without events

Applications that don't ship their own notification events, like web
browsers, had no way to play a sound for their notifications. Add a
"Play a sound" option with a sound picker to their settings page.

BUG: 435774

media.caption: Google Chrome's notification settings: only popups, history and badges; no way to get a sound.
Same page with the new "Play a sound" option enabled; Chrome's notification popup now plays message-new-instant.
